name: Nando's
covers: Dishes, sides, sauces and drinks in UK Nando's restaurants

order.intro: Nando's lists its chicken, sauces, extras and sides on their own, so tick each part of your order. Its pittas, wraps, rolls and burgers are on the Avoid list.

headline: Chicken and the PERi-PERi bastes list no gluten.
tips: Chicken and the PERi-PERi bastes list no gluten. Pittas, wraps, buns and some sides do, so have the chicken on its own or with a side listed here.
Tell the manager on duty: Nando's says to speak to them about an allergy so extra precautions can be taken.
Beers contain barley, so they're on the Avoid list here.
gaps: Nando's publishes its allergens as a page per dish, not as a guide; this app reads a copy taken on the date shown, so check the dish page or ask if it might have changed.
Nando's says it handles many allergens in its kitchens and can't guarantee any dish is allergen free.
The dish pages list allergens by recipe. They don't say how food is cooked, such as shared grills or fryers.
